document.abstract: High Definition Electronic Production, chosen for study and coordination by SMPTE Working Group N 15.04, is concerned with the arts and sciences of program production, as they are seen to be influenced by and benefit from a periphery of rapidly evolving sciences and technologies. Program origination is provided with a multiplicity of potential sources for captured and generated images; post-production offers an increasing palette of tools for merging and integrating source material to achieve maximum artistic impact; distribution channels and facilities are multiplying both in number and in diversity, and eagerly awaiting suitable good programs. Clear understanding and precise communication among the sciences and technologies has become an inescapable requirement.
